text: Your safe haven just lost 28% from its record, in the middle of a war.
Why is gold falling?
This week, a tax on Saudi oil sent Brent crude to $112.
Stocks are sliding.
Relax. This is my moment.
Then gold dipped below $4,000.
So why does the shield crack exactly when you need it?
First, gold pays you nothing.
A US government bond pays about 5%.
Oil means inflation.
Inflation means rates stay high and holding nothing gets expensive.
For once, paper wins!
Second, when stocks crash, people sell what they can, not what they love.
Gold is the cash machine, that's the mirage.
Gold isn't a crisis shield, it's mostly a bet that rates will fall.
So when a crisis pushes rates up, your safe haven isn't.
I'm sulking, deep, wounded pride, lying face down.
I'm not falling, I'm resting.
This is money mirage.
Follow for more.
